question: Which of the following is the first biosphere reserve established in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Nilgiri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve** was the first biosphere reserve established in India in the year **1986**.
 
• It is located in the **Western Ghats** and encompasses parts of the **states of Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and Karnataka**.
 
• The Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve is part of the **UNESCO World Network of Biosphere Reserves** since **2000**.
 
• This reserve is known for its **rich biodiversity**, including a variety of endemic flora and fauna.
 
• It is home to flagship species like the **Nilgiri Tahr**, **Asian Elephant**, and the **Tiger**.
 
• The Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve is an important conservation area for **tropical moist forests, tropical dry forests, and shrublands**.
 
• It also forms a critical part of the **Western Ghats**, which is one of the **eight “hottest hotspots” of biological diversity in the world**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sundarbans**__

 __
 
• The Sundarbans is a **UNESCO World Heritage Site** and is famous for its **mangrove forests**.
 
• It is home to the **Royal Bengal Tiger** and is located in the **delta region of the Ganges, Brahmaputra, and Meghna rivers**.
 
• It is also known for its **salt-tolerant plant species** and extensive network of tidal waterways.
 
 
 
• **Nanda Devi**__
 __
 
• The Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve is located in the state of **Uttarakhand**.
 
• It is also a **UNESCO World Heritage Site** and includes the **Nanda Devi and Valley of Flowers National Parks**.
 
• It is characterized by its **alpine meadows** and the **Nanda Devi peak**, the second-highest mountain in India.
 
 
 
• **Gulf of Mannar**__
 
 
• The Gulf of Mannar Biosphere Reserve is located along the **coast of Tamil Nadu**.
 
• It is known for its **marine biodiversity**, including **coral reefs, seagrass beds, and mangroves**.
 
• It is home to species like the **Dugong** and **Green Turtle**.
